item.title: FBI reviewing new message tied to Nancy Guthrie's apparent abduction
item.description: Tucson TV station KOLD said on Friday it received a new message, via email, tied to the Guthrie case. The station said it couldn’t disclose its contents.

item.title: Mighty Lights turn red for National Wear Red Day
item.description: MEMPHIS, Tenn. — The Might Lights are showing their support for National Wear Red Day, on Friday, to raise awareness for women's heart health. The downtown bridges are lit up in red along with many at WREG wearing red. The American Heart Association designated Feb. 6 as Go Red for Women Day to raise awareness [...]

item.title: Tunica community devastated by library fire
item.description: TUNICA, Miss. — Burned books and debris are what’s left of the Robert Irwin Library in Tunica, Mississippi after the building was engulfed in flames Thursday afternoon. WREG’s Katelyn Barker spoke to the fire chief and shares how crews were able to extinguish the fire. This is what’s left of the Robert C Irwin library. [...]

item.title: Body believed to be Lil Jon's missing son found in Georgia: Police
item.description: Nathan Smith, 27, also known professionally as DJ Young Slade, was last seen in Milton, Georgia, around 6 a.m. on Feb. 3.

item.description: MEMPHIS, Tenn. — The past couple weekends saw record low reports in serious crime as the Mid-South turned into a winter wonderland, but as the weather has gotten warmer the past few days, criminals in Memphis are coming out of hibernation.
